{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure clarity
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any order_id starting with 'TEST'
test_orders = sales_df[sales_df['order_id'].str.startswith('TEST')]

# Confirm no test orders are in completed orders
completed_test_orders = test_orders[test_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# If there are any, they should be excluded
if len(completed_test_orders) > 0:
    print(f"Found {len(completed_test_orders)} completed test orders. Excluding them.")
else:
    print("No completed test orders found.")

# Now compute total revenue from completed non-test orders
completed_non_test = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & ~sales_df['order_id'].str.startswith('TEST')]
total_revenue = completed_non_test['revenue'].sum()

# Print final result
total_revenue"}
